newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers rises with fuel oil cargo strength.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers rises with fuel oil cargo strength.

text.p: ARA bunkers rose sharply on Monday after barge gains, while other European prices presented a mixed picture, dealers said.
Demand was slight at most ports.
Rotterdam 380 cst fuel oil was up about $4 at $122 fob, spurred by a strengthening barge and cargo market, the latter in demand from U.S. buyers.
Bunker demand, by contrast, was only slight.
Hamburg bunkers ignored ARA gains and held at around $123 fob. However, buyers were not attracted by the relative cheapness of bunkers as their need was only slight.
Mediterranean bunkers were mixed. Southern France gained $2/$3 a tonne, but bunkers in Spanish and Italian ports dipped by $1/$2.
Spanish suppliers said demand improved from the latter part of last week.
Fujairah bunkers clung to highs of $120 fob as Singapore picked up.
